# Cloudflare Computer

A virtual filesystem and execution environment for AI agents that maintains authoritative state in SQLite.

**Link:** https://github.com/cloudflare/computer

## What creators claimed

- It gives AI agents persistent file memory across sessions and minimizes the need to spin up Linux containers for basic file operations. ([Db2FJERS0N_](../reels/Db2FJERS0N_.md))
